answers.core:
- one solution is to extend the Sprite Type, with an add-on can't do iirc
 - I was genuinely confused how this is not an option given how well the general integration of 2D, 3D and UI works with Godot
 - especially having a 3D-Parody of `SubViewportContainer` feels like a thing that should exist for consistency-sake
answers.workaround: [It has been demonstrated, that it can be done with a reasonable amount work.](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/72657#issuecomment-1416179892) So the question if this belongs to core now is more one of Convenience and Consistency.

title: Do we want to have Mouse Passtrough on Sprites / SubViewportSprite in Core?
